name: Weather Ball
description: You send a powerful ball of energy that changes type based on the surrounding weather. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If any of the following weather conditions are active, then double the damage dice and change the type of damage to the respective type indicated in the table.
higherLevels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 4d4 at level 10, and 3d10 at level 17.
